publisher: Federal Roads Office (FEDRO / ASTRA), Swiss Confederation

snapshot.format: tab-delimited TXT; CP1252; 223 data columns; 224 header fields with one trailing empty field

rights.data_license_status: Swiss Open Government Data (OGD); no separate CC identifier assigned in the reviewed ASTRA publication
rights.attribution: Source: Federal Roads Office (FEDRO / ASTRA), Type approval data (TARGA), third-generation automobile records (TG-Automobil.txt), source revision 2026-07-30; https://opendata.astra.admin.ch/ivzod/2000-Typengenehmigungen_TG_TARGA/2200-Basisdaten_TG_ab_1995/TG-Automobil.txt. Swiss Open Government Data (OGD). VAG-only research extraction; source rows and field values are unchanged where retained.
rights.evidence: ASTRA identifies TARGA type-approval information products as open data and states that standardized technical type-approval data are freely available. Swiss OGD policy permits reuse subject to source disclosure; opendata.swiss terms explain commercial use and mandatory attribution. Only the free factual type-approval file is included.

coverage.vehicle_group: TG-Automobil.txt only; includes passenger and other automobile classes present in the source

field_status.approval_number_and_date: raw official CH type-approval record fields
field_status.engine_make_type_and_marking: raw approval fields; Motorkennzeichen is a source engine-marking candidate, not independently confirmed as a VAG factory engine code
field_status.gearbox_1_to_4: raw approval gearbox classifications; not VAG gearbox codes
field_status.engine_gearbox_pair: not established; no pair table and no pair claim

source_manifest_notes: The engine marking and gearbox classifications are stored separately. No pair table is generated.
CH-only approval records do not establish RU/EAEU applicability, individual vehicle fitment, model year, generation, ECU, DTC or repair applicability.
